item.title: Local roundup: Cobras win Silver Stick banner; Konecny nears milestone
item.description: The Kent Cobras won the U15 A championship at the International Silver Stick boys finals Sunday in Port Huron, Mich.

item.title: David Brown's OT goal lifts Blenheim Blades past Amherstburg Admirals
item.description: David Brown scored 47 seconds into overtime Sunday as the Blenheim Blades rallied to beat the Amherstburg Admirals 5-4 in the Provincial Junior Hockey League.

item.title: Ken Baylis murder case won’t return to court until late 2026
item.description: A potential resolution for a man facing a murder charge will take many more months and likely extend into 2027. item.description: The breakdown of the boiler system at the Chatham hospital has sped up an infrastructure renewal plan by the Chatham-Kent Health Alliance. item.title: Council votes to keep PUC governance status quo
item.description: After a tie vote at a special council meeting Monday night, Chatham-Kent’s Public Utilities Commission will stick with its current governance structure, at least until the next council term.
